simple.meaning: עַלְוָן (ʻAlvân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Alvan or Aljan , an Idumaean.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַלְוָן (H5935) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 36:23, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַלְוָן (H5935) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַלְוָן (H5935) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַלְוָן (ʻAlvân) / H5935 is traced through Genesis 36:23, 1 Chronicles 1:40 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
